readme_excerpt: What is Notepad++ ?           Notepad++ is a free (free as in both "free speech" and "free beer") source code editor and Notepad replacement that supports several programming languages and natural languages. Running in the MS Windows environment, its use is governed by GPL License. See the Notepad++ official site for more information.
